tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List every page in a site, with its title, its address and when it last changed.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read one page of a site, including anything set at the top of it.

tools.name: find_references
tools.description: Find every passage that states a fact, including passages that say it a different way.

tools.name: history
tools.description: See the history of a site, and compare any two points in it.

tools.name: site_status
tools.description: Check whether a site is published, when it last went out, what it is on, and which changes are waiting to be kept.

tools.name: propose_edit
tools.description: Stage a set of changes — new pages, edits, deletions and moves together — and get a link to preview them before anything is kept.

tools.name: apply_edit
tools.description: Keep a staged set of changes, saved as a numbered version of the site.

tools.name: publish
tools.description: Put the current version of a site out for people to read.

tools.name: rollback
tools.description: Put a site, or one page of it, back to how it was at an earlier point.

tools.name: create_preview
tools.description: Turns markdown pages into a live preview site and returns a link to it. It takes the content already converted to markdown, one entry per page, and a record of where the content came from, exactly as it happened: a code repository, a documentation site's address, a product landing page's address, wr

tools.name: claim_draft
tools.description: Keep a preview as a site of your own and choose the name for its web address. Leave the name out and you will be offered some that are free. Keeping a preview confirms the content is yours, or that you have permission to publish it; this is recorded.

tools.name: set_branding
tools.description: Change how a site looks: its theme, main colour, typeface, header links, logo and icon. Only the site's owner can do this. Give only the things to change. A logo or icon is taken from an address you give; say images_are_ours: true only when the owner has told you the pictures are theirs to use — oth

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "create_preview" is 1824 chars, far longer than this server's median (83). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
